input: Project brief for ServicePebble Hours Ledger: The objective is to record volunteer service entries, verify completed service, and add approved entries to each volunteer's service record. Volunteers submit service entries and add response notes to disputed entries. Team Supervisors record entries as verified or disputed. Program Coordinators add only verified entries to volunteer service records. Records Leads close service periods after every submitted entry is added or left disputed. Volunteer reimbursement and shift scheduling are excluded.
